preconditions.description: The number of elements in the set S is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
Each element in the set S is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, inclusive.
All elements in the set S are distinct.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer x, representing the largest possible x for which a magical permutation exists.
The output is a permutation of integers from 0 to 2^x - 1 that satisfies the condition that the bitwise xor of any two consecutive elements is in S.
